name: Whispering Ashling
languages: understands Common; speaks only in whispers

specialAbilities.name: Whispering Cinders
specialAbilities.description: The ashling murmurs without pause in a voice like settling ash. A creature that listens closely hears fragments of Malarok's commands.

specialAbilities.name: Ash Form
specialAbilities.description: The ashling can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Ash Touch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Fire damage.
